newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street Deli sells Memphis division.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street Deli sells Memphis division.

text.p: Wall Street Deli Inc said Wednesday it has agreed to sell the operating assets of its Memphis division to a new company formed by two of its executives for about $1.1 million.
The assets include 10 sandwich shops and Wall Street Deli's Memphis catering business.
The sale is for $850,000 in cash plus 25,000 shares of Wall Street Deli stock, at closing, with the balance payable in cash in two years, the company said. Closing is expected October 27.
The buyers are the present manager of the Memphis division, Judy Gupton, and Robert Barrow, president and chief executive officer of Wall Street Deli Inc, the company said.
Gupton will serve as president and chief executive of the new company. Barrow is an investor in the new company and will retain his positions at Wall Street Deli Inc, the company said.
